second_checker_limit: Independent witness formulation shares the verified record decoder and source-grounded facts; it is not a human or independently staffed review.

statistics.meaning: Binary-label completion bounds, not confidence intervals. Native-rest-fixed sensitivity assumes all unaudited source labels unchanged; sparse semantic bounds treat every unaudited label as unknown. No new significance or noninferiority/equivalence test.
statistics.original_fixed_sequence: S2 closes the gate; S3 remains descriptive. No historical statistic is overwritten.
